    StartersEnrique's bean and cheese quesadillasCrisp tortillas with refried beans, cheddar and jalapeños, salsa and sour creamHow to make it4 large flour tortillas400g refried beans200g cheddar, grated1 jar pickled jalapenos, sliced200g tomato salsa150g sour creamSpread each tortilla with refried beans over half, scatter with cheddar and jalapenos and fold over.Toast in a dry pan over medium heat, pressing down, until crisp and the cheese melts, turning once.Cut into wedges and serve with the salsa and sour cream.Border run chicken empanadasBaked pastry turnovers filled with smoky chicken, egg and olivesHow to make it400g chicken thigh mince1 onion, diced1 tsp ground cumin1 tsp sweet paprika3 eggs50g pitted green olives, chopped3 sheets of shortcrust pastryBoil two of the eggs until hard, then cool, peel and chop.Fry the chicken mince and onion with the cumin and paprika until browned.Stir in the chopped eggs and olives and cool the filling.Cut the pastry into 12 rounds, fill, fold and crimp the edges.Brush with the remaining beaten egg. Bake at 200°C until golden.Elote with cotija and chilliSarah asks Enrique for clothes, food and a truck.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsDesert camp tacosLime and cumin marinated skirt steak in corn tortillas with dried chilli salsaHow to make it800g skirt steak2 limes4 garlic cloves1 tsp ground cumin3 dried chillies1 tomato16 corn tortillas1 onion, finely diced1 bunch corianderMarinate the steak in lime juice, three of the garlic cloves and the cumin in the fridge.Soak the dried chillies in hot water, then blitz with the tomato and remaining garlic for a salsa roja.Grill the steak on high heat, then rest and slice against the grain.Warm the tortillas and serve with the steak, salsa, onion and coriander.Galleria food court double smash burgerThe Galleria mall chaseHow to make itAs written, serves 4Two thin patties smashed on a smoking griddle with American cheese, pickles, shredded lettuce and tangy burger sauce, wrapped tight in paper.Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls.Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp relish and 1 tsp mustard for sauce.Heat a griddle until smoking, add the balls and smash flat with a spatula.Season and cook 2 minutes until crusty, flip and top with cheese for 1 minute.Toast 4 buns.Stack two patties on each with sauce, shredded lettuce and pickles, then wrap in baking paper for 2 minutes.SweetsEnrique's camp churrosFried churros rolled in cinnamon sugar with a hot chocolate dipHow to make it250ml water30g butterpinch of salt150g plain flour1 egg2 L vegetable oil80g caster sugar2 tsp ground cinnamon150ml thickened cream150g dark chocolate, choppedBoil the water, butter and salt, then beat in the flour until it forms a ball.
